thread.title: Tech stocks drop in late trading after Apple trims forecast

author: Jeremy C. Owens
title: Tech stocks drop in late trading after Apple trims forecast
text:
Some of the biggest names in technology saw shares decline in after-hours trading Wednesday, after Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.11% trimmed its forecast for holiday sales . Apple suppliers were some of the hardest hit, with Skyworks Solutions Inc. SWKS, +1.40% Qorvo Inc. QRVO, +0.74% and Broadcom Inc. AVGO, -0.30% all down at least 5% as of 6 p.m. Eastern time. Other members of the so-called "FAANG" grouping of tech stocks were also hit: Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +2.47% dropped about 3%, Facebook Inc. FB, +3.50% was down 1.6%, Alphabet Inc. GOOG, +0.99% GOOGL, +0.93% declined almost 2%, and Netflix Inc. NFLX, +0.00% declined about 3%. Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.44% which took the title as most valuable public company in the U.S. from Apple late last year, was down more than 2%. Chip makers Nvidia Corp. NVDA, +2.04% Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD, +2.00% and Micron Technology Inc. MU, +3.21% all saw shares decline 3% or more as well.
See Full Story Apple cuts holiday sales forecast on iPhone and China weakness, stock falls 8% Apple Inc. lowered its holiday-quarter revenue forecast Wednesday afternoon, largely due to slowing iPhone sales and pressure in China.
